g.text: Constructed intervention: delays with every missed recovery retained
Intersection scope; 30 points per method/setting. Black diamond = mean restricted delay. An alert at block 6 has delay 0; no alert during blocks 6–20 is
retained at 15, not dropped. Any-view recovery may be unrelated to the target; the right panels require an alert in SEX=2 & RAC1P=2. Zero alerts is a
result, not evidence that the implementation is accurate.
